scope: Reject incomplete Composio writes before creating a confirmation and recheck current input constraints before dispatch. Google Sheets append requires an explicit spreadsheet and range and cannot substitute for creating tables.

keep: Existing provider discovery, tenant and account binding, immutable approval and one-attempt dispatch
extend: Check bounded common constraints from the selected tool's current input schema and ask for clarification without generating an invalid approval

tenant.description: No changes to account or tenant selection.

approval.description: Incomplete writes cannot reach approval or dispatch; no approval is bypassed.

egress.description: Reduces write egress by rejecting incomplete plans before dispatch; no new destinations or requests.

cost.description: No additional planner call, provider reservation or new pricing rules.

tests.scope: Blank spreadsheet destination, incompatible table operation, nested required fields, schema bounds and valid positive controls.
Runtime planner returns clarification and no plan when provider metadata requires a missing input.
An approved plan missing a field required by the current tool schema does not reach the provider effect.

architecture.reason: Extends existing preparation and execution paths without adding an orchestrator or a provider.

rollout: Run mandatory CI and isolated Workspace checks before any live promotion. Verify ambiguous Sheets writes ask for destination and a fully specified test write still requires approval.
rollback: Revert the commit or restore the preceding approved Cloud Run revision; no database change.
knownGaps: Only common bounded schema constraints are enforced; this does not certify all JSON Schema keywords, all tool-selection semantics or provider operations.
A workflow with missing action details must be explicitly reissued; the response warns about previously completed steps.

blockers: Exact-source CI, isolated authenticated staging and live verification are outstanding.
